- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that live performances allow for personal connections between performers and audiences, showcasing skills in real-time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledged that while virtual shows have advantages like convenience and accessibility, they cannot replace the essence of live performances.
